decisions.reason: As a close-to-core bread that survived its launch year on the website and fits existing bakery capabilities, it likely met at least a satisfactory aspiration level and is cheap to carry in a growing market.
The tour disappeared from the website after launch, suggesting performance below aspiration, and management would reallocate those hospitality resources to stronger core bakery and event activities.

This sweet pastry is tightly aligned with the firm's established offer, remained visible beyond launch, and with no sign of firm distress the firm has enough slack to retain such an incremental product.

A farmhouse bread is a low-risk extension of the traditional range, and in the absence of clear failure signals management would keep it because it uses existing recipes, sourcing, and production routines efficiently.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen earned a gold award, which places its performance above social aspiration levels and strongly supports continuing it as a seasonal flagship product.
The premium Christmas stollen also received a gold award, so it clearly exceeds aspiration benchmarks and should be retained as a high-reputation seasonal offering.
